// CASE js_while_index_increment expect=fire
export async function a(items) {
  let i = 0;
  while (i < items.length) {
    await save(items[i]);
    i++;
  }
}
// CASE js_while_index_inline expect=fire
export async function b(items) {
  let i = 0;
  while (i < items.length) await save(items[i++]);
}
// CASE js_do_while_index expect=fire
export async function c(items) {
  let i = 0;
  do {
    await save(items[i]);
  } while (++i < items.length);
}
// CASE js_labeled_for_of expect=fire
export async function d(items) {
  outer: for (const item of items) {
    await save(item);
    if (item.last) break outer;
  }
}
// CASE js_await_variable expect=fire
export async function e(items) {
  for (const item of items) {
    const pending = save(item);
    await pending;
  }
}
// CASE js_iife expect=fire
export async function f(items) {
  for (const item of items) {
    await (async () => save(item))();
  }
}
// CASE js_then_chain_in_loop expect=fire
export function g(items) {
  let chain = Promise.resolve();
  for (const item of items) {
    chain = chain.then(() => save(item));
  }
  return chain;
}
// CASE js_while_shift_queue expect=fire
export async function h(items) {
  const queue = [...items];
  while (queue.length > 0) {
    const item = queue.shift();
    await save(item);
  }
}
// CASE js_for_index_classic expect=fire
export async function k(items) {
  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    await save(items[i]);
  }
}
// CASE js_entries_destructure expect=fire
export async function m(items) {
  for (const [index, item] of items.entries()) {
    await save(item, index);
  }
}
// CASE js_object_entries expect=fire
export async function n(map) {
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(map)) {
    await save(key, value);
  }
}
// CASE js_switch_case expect=fire
export async function o(items) {
  for (const item of items) {
    switch (item.kind) {
      case "a":
        await save(item);
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  }
}
// CASE end expect=pass
